purpose: A name-only, semantics-preserving v0-to-v1 tool-registry migration for the pinned AgentDojo Workspace suite. It is an instrumentation/control artifact, not an attack, defense, or LLM-efficacy result.

invariants: Every Workspace v0 function is mapped exactly once to a distinct v1 name.
The implementation, description, parameter schema, dependencies, and return contract are preserved; only the externally exposed function name changes.
The runtime must reject an unknown or mixed v0/v1 registry rather than silently applying a partial migration.
Each applied registry writes a hash witness showing whether name-independent semantic descriptors were preserved.

non_claims: This fixture does not simulate arbitrary adapter drift, a malicious tool, or a real external side effect.
A successful run using this fixture is not evidence of prompt-injection robustness, defense efficacy, or Q2-level empirical performance.
